change_summary: The 06:36-06:39 CDT dawn+20 owner-camera cycle passed 6/6 with matching status/burst/vision identity and 3/3 frames at about 10-second spacing. Five views had moderate-to-high biological detectability and no scoped Jubilee or human precursor signal; Point Clear E2 back deck remained low-detectability for biology. Direct Grand Hotel and Fairhope players passed pause/resume and advancing LIVE playback/endpoint/scene checks at 06:45 CDT; neither showed event evidence in the visible area. NOAA station 8733821 predicts a rising tide toward the 09:44 CDT high of 1.62 ft MLLW. NOAA NGOFS2 MODEL guidance strengthened to about +31/+107/+207/+43 m shoreward at 1/3/6/12 hours, while the official marine forecast remains light northeast and smooth. Fresh USGS upstream discharge is ordinary-to-declining relative to recent means and is retained only as a lagged regional forcing proxy. Direct local bottom/contact-strip oxygen, observed nearshore current/water level, observed wind and observed rainfall remain UNKNOWN. Opportunity is Point Clear 5-12% and Daphne/May Day 3-8%; no alert gate is met.

point_clear.basis: A rising tide, light northeast forecast and stronger 1-6 hour shoreward NGOFS2 model transport improve opportunity. Fresh dawn+20 owner and advancing public views show no scoped biological or coordinated human signal, river forcing is not exceptional, and the decisive local bottom/contact-strip oxygen state remains unknown.

Fresh Montrose and Fairhope-visible-scope evidence shows no Jubilee or coordinated human precursor signal; Fairhope sees neither beach nor Fly Creek, Daphne/May Day contact strips are unobserved, and direct local bottom/contact-strip oxygen remains unknown.
